# INCUBEX 2026

> INCUBEX 2026 is Ignisia's tech launchpad and project expo at MIT-WPU Pune on 21 October 2026.

## Official resources

- [Official INCUBEX 2026 website](https://incubex.ignisia.tech/)
- [Registration on Unstop](https://unstop.com/p/incubex-by-ignisia-2026-national-level-tech-launchpad-mit-world-peace-university-pune-maharashtra-1759743)
- [Official INCUBEX 2026 brochure](https://incubex.ignisia.tech/assets/incubex-brochure-2026.pdf)
- [Ignisia organizer website](https://ignisia.tech/)

## Verified event facts

- Date: 21 October 2026
- Venue: Dr. Vishwanath Karad MIT World Peace University, Kothrud, Pune, Maharashtra, India
- Format: Online screening followed by an on-campus Grand Finale
- Tracks: Product Track and Prototype Expo Track
- Audience: Diploma, undergraduate and postgraduate students aged 16–22 across India; all members of a team must attend the same college
- Team sizes: 1-6 members
- Registration fee: INR 300 per team; free for MIT-WPU Pune students
- Registration closes: 14 October 2026
- Online qualifier rounds: 15–16 October 2026
- Round 1 results: 17 October 2026 (10:00 AM)
- Online mentoring sessions: 15–16 October 2026
- Prize pool: INR 50,000+; Prototype Expo: first INR 20,000, second INR 15,000; Product Track: first INR 10,000; shared consolation pool INR 5,000
- Finalists: 80 teams, comprising 30 Product Track teams and 50 Prototype Expo Track teams

For current deadlines, rules, eligibility, and registration status, use the official website, brochure, and Unstop registration page above.
